summary: 44-year-old backcountry skier from Lakewood killed in an avalanche at Nitro Chute on Berthoud Pass; his three teenage sons were also caught, one fully buried but rescued.
location: Nitro Chute, Berthoud Pass (~11,500 ft), near Winter Park
responding_agency: Grand County Sheriff's Office; Grand County Search and Rescue
notes: Man touring with three teenage sons; one son fully buried and rescued by bystanders/family but father died at scene; another son partially buried; fourth escaped mid-slide; first CO avalanche death of the 2022-23 season. merged KVNF regional newscast (Dec 29, 2022): first 2022-23 CO avalanche death, west side of Berthoud Pass near Winter Park, 44-yo.
